messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — Azure Marketplace asked for SOC 2 report + network pen-test artifacts for listing. They want attestation by EOM. Any blockers?

maria: Which SOC scope do they want? prod infra only or also private deployment (VPC/on-prem)?

alex: They listed 'production inference and control plane' — so Hosted + Dedicated. Also asked for pen-test summary + remediation timeline.

sam: We have SOC 2 Type II from 2024 but need carve-out details. I can pull the bridge letter and control mapping. ETA EOD tomorrow.

emily: I'll coordinate with partnerships to push timeline. Can someone confirm if we can share the full pen-test report or only an executive summary? Marketplace legal flagged red if PII shows up in reports.

security-bot: Reminder: internal policy requires redaction of vuln chatter before external sharing. Use `tools/redact-report.sh` and record the action in `doc_control`.

maria: Good point. We should provide the full report under NDA/secure upload to the marketplace portal, and an exec summary for the public listing. I'll draft an upload checklist.

parth: For SI integration partners they might need firmware attestation and STIG-like checklists. Hardware partners also ask for firmware CVE mitigations — do we have an inventory to reference?

alex: Hardware inventory is in Eng Infra confluence; I can paste a sanitized export. But need approval from Security for any distribution.

sam: Pen-test vendor says they'll need ~2 weeks to re-run validation after fixes. Can we commit to that window if we tell the marketplace it's 'in progress'?

emily: Partnerships prefers not to block listing — we can submit SOC + exec summary and mark pen-test as 'in progress' with a remediation timeline. Does Azure review accept that?

azure-rep: (external) We can accept SOC + remediation plan, but policy requires either completed pen-test or an NDA'd full report uploaded within 30 days of initial submission.

alex: Ok — plan: NDA upload within 30 days. Maria, Sam, can we get the NDA-ready package by next Wednesday?

maria: Yes — I'll assemble: SOC2 bridge letter, control mapping, exec pen-test summary, artifact checklist, and contact info for NDA upload.

sam: I'll coordinate with the vendor to prepare a sanitized report and confirm redaction steps. Expect a draft by Tue.

emily: I'll notify marketplace PMs and tag the listing status as `pending security artifacts` so marketing and engineering know.

jordan: FYI, marketing wants to align joint announcement timing — request is to hold public comms until marketplace listing is live. I'll sync with you after artifacts are uploaded.

alex: I'll create a Google collector form for artifacts and add the `partnerships-security` tag. Also adding a timeline column: SOC, Exec Summary, Full Report (NDA), Firmware Inventory, Vendor Remediation ETA.

security-bot: Action items created: `collect-soc-bridge` (maria), `redact-pen-test` (sam), `nda-upload` (alex). Please update status in the tracker.

maria: Adding notes and the draft checklist here: https://rwd.co/safe-share/marketplace-security-upload — will mark required files and redaction instructions.

alex: Great. I'll follow up with legal about the NDA template and provide the secure upload link to Azure once signed.

emily: Thanks — I'll draft the partners-facing note so SIs and hardware partners know what to expect.

alex: Closing thread for now; will repost updates in #partnerships when upload complete :thumbsup:
